items: 【All Gigabit Ports】 Includes 4 Gigabit POE ports, 1 Gigabit UpLink Ethernet port, all ports up to 100/1000Mbps speed, has excellent network performance. The Uplink may be connected to a variety of network devices, including NVRs, routers, servers, and more.

【78W High PoE Power】 Support IEEE 802.3af/at PoE power supply. The whole power is 78W, up to 30W per port. All ports support PoE, and support automatic detection, can connect POE and non-POE devices. Suitable for poe power supply for multiple devices.

【Unmanaged Switch】Plug and Play, no configuration required, can be easy installed. Support wall mount and pole mount, all installation kits included. Flexibility to mount the YuanLey outdoor waterproof switch anywhere you need it.
【One Key VLAN】 When the VLAN mode is enabled, all PoE ports support VLAN isolation, the traffic are isolated from each other, improve the network safety.

【Ideal For Outdoor Use】Perfect for rough weather conditions. One-piece molding shell and seamless design with an IP65 Waterproof rating, it's built to withstand the toughest outdoor environment. Plus, it offers 4KV lightning protection. Order now and enjoy uninterrupted network connectivity, come rain or shine!
